changes: Core writes request-digest execution claim before answer/retest worker invocation.
Unfinished/conflicting claim refuses repeat with 409 and prior execution UNVERIFIED.
Returned worker failures permit explicit same-request retry only after failure state persistence.
Committed positive/withheld history is still checked before claim admission.
limitations: No live Core crash during real model execution tested.
No latest Tauri native build/runtime acceptance yet.
UI pending_machine durable request restoration is not implemented.
Legacy answers without client_request_id have no cross-request stable key.
Claims are conservative barriers; no general exactly-once guarantee.

ui_identity_followup.behavior: All newly submitted Panel answers now carry fixed client_request_id, including unscoped launch-default requests; lost-ACK retries reuse the full original body.
ui_identity_followup.scope_limit: Direct legacy API clients may still omit client_request_id. UI cross-exit pending_machine restoration remains incomplete.
